## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-juan Northern-Sòng collected-commentaries edition of the *[Huángdì yīnfú jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0031)* compiled by Cáo Xīyùn 曹希蘊 (*fl.* eleventh century), the notable Sòng poetess-and-Daoist. The text presents the short version of the scripture (c. 300 words) in three paragraphs. Under the *Dàozàng jíyào* title *Shízhēn jíjiě* 十真集解 ("Collected Explanations by the Ten Perfected") it presents commentary-strata attributed to ten Daoist authorities.

**Abstract**

Florian C. Reiter, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 2:694 (§3.A.1), dates the compilation to Cáo Xīyùn's Northern-Sòng *floruit*. The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 1000 / notAfter 1100, with dynasty 北宋. Cáo Xīyùn is the sole catalog-meta person wikilinked.
